senses.gloss: सु—ख॑ &c., see सुख॑ s.v.

सुख॑ mfn. (said to be fr. 5. सु + 3. ख, and to mean originally ‘having a good axle-hole’; possibly a Prākṛt form of सु-स्थ, q.v.; cf. दुःख) running swiftly or easily (only applied to cars or chariots, superl. सुख॑-तम), easy, RV.
